say:1:1430251401:1.text: Yes, after the Queen passed away, many people in the royal city said as much.
say:1:1430251401:1.source_cn: 是的，女王崩逝后，有不少人在王城里宣传这件事。
say:1:1430251401:1.male: Yes, after the Queen passed away, many people in the royal city said as much.
say:1:1430251401:1.female: Yes, after the Queen passed away, many people in the royal city said as much.

say:2:1430251402:1.text: It turns out that the veil we all wore was meant to cover up this secret.
say:2:1430251402:1.source_cn: 原来我们之前佩戴的面纱，也正是为了遮盖这个秘密。
say:2:1430251402:1.male: It turns out that the veil we all wore was meant to cover up this secret.
say:2:1430251402:1.female: It turns out that the veil we all wore was meant to cover up this secret.
